scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.deploy:web: pnpm run build:hosting && pnpm dlx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting --project sarbedutech
scripts.preview:web: pnpm run build:hosting && pnpm dlx firebase-tools hosting:channel:deploy preview --project sarbedutech
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.typecheck:admin: pnpm --dir artifacts/admin-app typecheck >/dev/null && pnpm --dir artifacts/api-server exec esbuild src/quant-v4/topics/AdvancedMathematics/subtopics/Mensuration/MEN-002/MEN-CP-008/review/export-html.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --log-level=error --outfile=dist/quant-v4/men-cp008-review-export.mjs >/dev/null && node artifacts/api-server/dist/quant-v4/men-cp008-review-export.mjs >/dev/null && cat artifacts/api-server/dist/review/MEN-CP-008-English-Review.html
scripts.build:hosting: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:admin && node scripts/assemble-hosting.mjs
